table_name.header_chain: List of rice dishes > List of rice dishes

rows.Name: Akhni
rows.Description: Mixed rice and meat dish, a variant of pilaf .

rows.Name: Akki rotti
rows.Description: "Rice bread", a rice-based breakfast item unique to the state of Karnataka , India

rows.Name: Albaloo polo
rows.Description: Sour (morello) cherries in pilaf rice, usually made with spices like saffron and advieh .

rows.Name: American fried rice ( Thai )
rows.Description: This is a dish from Thai cuisine where the rice is fried with tomato ketchup and raisins

rows.Name: Ampaw
rows.Description: Filipino sweet puffed rice cake. It is traditionally made with sun-dried leftover cooked white rice that is fried and coated with syrup.

rows.Name: Appam
rows.Description: Appam is a type of pancake , originating from South India , made with fermented rice batter and coconut milk. A common delicacy in Tamil Nadu , Sri Lanka and Kerala .

rows.Name: Arancini
rows.Description: Breaded and deep fried stuffed rice balls

rows.Name: Arem-arem
rows.Description: Made of compressed rice cake in the form of a cylinder wrapped inside a banana leaf, filled with diced vegetables, tempeh or oncom, sometimes also filled with minced meat or abon (beef floss), and eaten as snack.

rows.Name: Arroz caldo
rows.Description: Thin rice porridge cooked with chicken, ginger , onions and garnished with spring onions, toasted garlic and calamansi

rows.Name: Arroz chaufa
rows.Description: "Chow fun rice" Chinese fried rice with a Peruvian twist

rows.Name: Arroz borracho
rows.Description: Rice cooked with sazón , sofrito, chickpeas, ground meat, and beer.

rows.Name: Arroz con gandules
rows.Description: A part of the Puerto Rican gastronomy consisting of a combination of rice, pigeon peas , olives, capers, and pork, cooked in the same pot with Puerto Rican-style sofrito , spices and annatto oil.

rows.Name: Arroz con huevo frito
rows.Description: Rice with fried egg

rows.Name: Arroz con maiz
rows.Description: "Rice with corn", the dish is made in both Cuba and Puerto Rico. It's made with rice, corn, sausage, wine, annatto, tomatoes, sofrito and other ingredients.

rows.Name: Arroz con pollo
rows.Description: "Rice with chicken", the dish, which originated in Spain as a form of pilaf , is a staple throughout Latin America .      It is a traditional dish of Latin America and the Caribbean , especially in Puerto Rico , Colombia , Venezuela , Ecuador , Panama , Peru , Cuba , Costa Rica , Honduras , the Dominican Republic , where it is called locrio de pollo, and Saint Martin , where it is called lokri or locreo.

rows.Name: Arroz de lisa (mullet rice)
rows.Description: Traditionally served in bijao leaf with cooked cassava , a triangle of costeño cheese and a sauce of suero atollabuey

rows.Name: Arròs negre
rows.Description: "Black rice", dish blackened with cuttlefish ink

rows.Name: Ayimolou
rows.Description: Dish made from rice and beans with sauce and meat, fish and/or eggs similar to waakye

rows.Name: Baghali polo
rows.Description: A rice dish prepared with lima beans and dill .

rows.Name: Balao-balao
rows.Description: A Filipino condiment of made from fermented cooked rice and whole raw shrimp

rows.Name: Bannu Pulao
rows.Description: A traditional mixed rice dish from the Bannu District of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa , Pakistan. It is made with beef, rice, spices, and stock. The beef is cooked with bones and marrow, which gives the dish a rich and flavorful taste. The rice is cooked separately with ghee, salt, and whole spices. The dish is served with a garnish of onions, green chilies, and lemon wedges.

rows.Name: Bánh chưng
rows.Description: This is a cake-dish usually eaten on Tet, Vietnamese new year eve, which is pork in the center, mashed mung bean and rice wrapped in leaves.

rows.Name: Ba-wan
rows.Description: This is a savory snack food made from rice paste, meat, and usually shiitake mushrooms and bamboo shoots . It is often found at Taiwan night markets. Also called "rou-wan-zhi."

rows.Name: Bai pong moan
rows.Description: A rice and egg dish with several variations.

rows.Name: Baye baye
rows.Description: A Filipino dish made from grated young coconut mixed with either newly harvested rice (pinipig) or corn and shaped into patties.

rows.Name: Bhakari
rows.Description: A type of bread which is prepared by mixing rice dough and water and then heated dry or roasted on a type of flat vessel called tawa, mostly in the coastal districts of kokan region which includes palghar, thane, Mumbai, raigad, ratnagiri, sindhudurg of maharashtra and goa.

rows.Name: Bibimbap
rows.Description: Mixed vegetables on rice with egg or meat on top

rows.Name: Bibingka
rows.Description: A rice cake usually eaten during Christmas . May be topped with cottage cheese, salted egg or freshly grated shredded young coconut meat.

rows.Name: Biko
rows.Description: A sweet dish made of sticky rice cooked in coconut milk and sugar and topped with thick caramelized coconut syrup and latik

rows.Name: Binignit
rows.Description: A Visayan dessert soup from the central Philippines. The dish is traditionally made with glutinous rice cooked in coconut milk with various slices of sabá bananas, taro, ube, and sweet potato, among other ingredients.

rows.Name: Biryani
rows.Description: Preparation of spicy fried rice with meat, fish, chicken, and vegetables.

rows.Name: Bisi bele bath
rows.Description: A rice-based dish with its origins in the state of Karnataka , India . Bisi-bele-bhaath translates to hot lentil rice in the Kannada language. The traditional preparation of this dish is quite elaborate and involves the use of spicy masala , toor dal (a type of lentil) and vegetables . Spices like nutmeg and asafoetida , curry leaves and tamarind pulp used in its preparation contribute to the unique flavor and taste of this dish.

rows.Name: Black beans and rice
rows.Description: A very popular side dish, or entrée if done right.

rows.Name: Bhaat
rows.Description: Rice that has been cooked either by steaming or boiling.

rows.Name: Bhelpuri
rows.Description: Bhelpuri is a savoury snack, originating from the Indian subcontinent , and is also a type of chaat . It is made of puffed rice , vegetables and a tangy tamarind sauce.

rows.Name: Bokkeumbap
rows.Description: Fried rice, usually with some other ingredient, like kimchi bokkeumbap ( Kimchi fried rice)

rows.Name: Boribap
rows.Description: Rice boiled with barley

rows.Name: Boudin
rows.Description: Cajun rice dressing stuffed into a sausage casing.

rows.Name: Bubur ayam
rows.Description: An Indonesian chicken congee, served with condiments such as chopped scallion , crispy fried shallot , and tongcay (preserved salted vegetables) .

rows.Name: Bubur pedas
rows.Description: Bubur pedas is made from finely ground sauteed rice and grated coconut. The stock is made either from tetelan (bony meat such as ribs) or chicken broth.

rows.Name: Burasa
rows.Description: Cooked with coconut milk packed inside a banana leaf pouch

rows.Name: Burong isda
rows.Description: A Filipino dish consisting of cooked rice and raw filleted fish fermented with salt and angkak (red yeast rice) for around a week.

rows.Name: Buttered rice
rows.Description: Buttered rice uses long-grained paw hsan hmwe or basmati rice , and in its most basic form, is cooked with butter , lentils , and bay leaves . Cashew nuts and raisins may be added, and the dish can be spiced with cinnamon sticks , cardamom pods or cloves , and garnished with fried golden onions to serve. It is typically paired with a traditional Burmese or Indian influenced chicken or mutton curry.

rows.Name: Cabidela
rows.Description: Rice with chicken or rabbit meat.

rows.Name: Carri
rows.Description: Rice, with chicken or beef, tomatoes, chili and curry

rows.Name: Chalbap
rows.Description: Cooked sweet rice mixed with red beans, jujubes and chestnuts

rows.Name: Champorado
rows.Description: Sweet chocolate rice porridge

rows.Name: Chao
rows.Description: Vietnamese rice congee, sometimes cooked with pandan leaves or mung bean .

rows.Name: Charleston red rice
rows.Description: Also known as Savannah red rice and as red rice.

rows.Name: Chazuke
rows.Description: Dashi , green tea, or hot water poured over cooked rice. Common toppings include Japanese pickles ( tsukemono ), nori , and fish roe such as tarako or mentaiko .

rows.Name: Chelow
rows.Description: Iranian Basmati rice with saffron, and sometimes served with tadig (can also be written as challow, chalo).

rows.Name: Chiayi turkey rice
rows.Description: This is a bowl of rice with shredded turkey layered on top, often accompanied by pickled radish . The rice is drizzled with a kind of gravy made from the turkey drippings and soy sauce .

rows.Name: Chitranna
rows.Description: This is a rice preparation made by sauteing groundnut , sesame seeds , red chili and turmeric in oil and adding it to cooked rice and mixing.

rows.Name: Ci fan tuan
rows.Description: Prepared by tightly wrapping a piece of youtiao (fried dough) with glutinous rice .

rows.Name: Claypot rice
rows.Description: A rice casserole. The rice is cooked in the claypot and the cooked ingredients such as proteins and vegetables are added in later. Some places serve it with dark soya sauce. Traditionally, the cooking is done over a charcoal stove, giving the dish a distinctive flavor.

rows.Name: Cơm hến
rows.Description: A dish in Vietnamese cuisine made using rice, cooked baby river mussels , rice, peanuts, pork rinds, shrimp paste, chili paste, starfruits and bạc hà stems.

rows.Name: Cơm tấm
rows.Description: A dish in Vietnamese cuisine made from rice with fractured rice grains. Tấm refers to the broken rice grains , while cơm refers to cooked rice.

rows.Name: Concoction rice
rows.Description: A Nigerian dish made using rice, palm oil, salt, and other seasonings.

rows.Name: Congee
rows.Description: A type of porridge. Sometimes called "rice congee" but often simply shortened to "congee." There is a large variety of congee in Hong Kong and it is eaten very frequently as a staple food . The base is made by boiling rice then letting it simmer for a long time. Different ingredients are added depending on the region. The length of the simmering also varies by region. Cantonese congee is generally cooked longer for a smoother texture.

rows.Name: Coriander rice
rows.Description: Easily made by using boiled Basmati rice , coriander paste, oil, chana dal , onion , peas , ginger and garlic paste, Indian spices , lemon juice and salt.

rows.Name: Curd rice
rows.Description: Simple preparations are a mixture of boiled rice and yogurt. More complex variations also exist.

rows.Name: Curry rice
rows.Origin: Japan , also popular in other parts of East and Southeast Asia
rows.Description: Although curry is often eaten with rice in many countries it is seen as a main dish. The Japanese karē raisu (lit. "curry rice") though, is a standard combination of rice with a British influenced Japanese curry, of which there exist several types.

rows.Name: Dal bhat
rows.Description: Rice and lentil soup.

rows.Name: Danbauk
rows.Description: Burmese style Biryani .

rows.Name: Diri djondjon
rows.Description: Rice in a sauce of djondjon or black mushrooms.

rows.Name: Dirty rice
rows.Description: Pictured is dirty rice topped with a pork chop .

rows.Name: Dolma
rows.Origin: Armenia , Azerbaijan , Turkey , Middle East , Greece , Georgia
rows.Description: Grape leaves , eggplant , zucchini, peppers, onion, or tomatoes stuffed with rice.

rows.Name: Dosa
rows.Description: Rice and lentil pancakes with origins in Tamil Nadu , and Karnataka . Popular breakfast dish in South India.

rows.Name: Espasol
rows.Description: A cylinder-shaped Filipino rice cake. Originating from the province of Laguna, it is traditionally sold during the Christmas season. It is made from rice flour cooked in coconut milk and sweetened coconut strips and, afterwards, dusted with toasted rice flour.

rows.Name: Étouffée
rows.Description: Found in both Cajun and Creole cuisine, Étouffée is typically prepared with shellfish over rice. The dish employs a technique known as smothering , a popular method of cooking in the Cajun areas of southwest Louisiana .

rows.Name: Flattened rice
rows.Description: Flattened Rice is plain parboiled rice flattened into flat, light, dry flakes originating from the Indian subcontinent .

rows.Name: Fried rice
rows.Description: A dish of cooked rice that has been stir-fried in a wok or a frying pan and is usually mixed with other ingredients such as eggs , vegetables , seafood , or meat .

rows.Name: Fried rice ( India )
rows.Description: Basmati rice or other long grain rice boiled and then fried in oil or ghee with shrimp , egg, chicken, soy sauce , spices and various types of vegetables like carrots , green beans , bell peppers , onions, tomatoes, green onions , peas , celery etc.

rows.Name: Fried rice ((Nigerian))
rows.Description: Fried rice made with thyme, bay leaves, west african curry powder, pepper, assorted vegetables, fried liver, sometimes with shrimp and sausage. Paired with Meat, fish or eggs and coleslaw or plantain and moin moin .

rows.Name: Fried rice ( Myanmar )
rows.Description: Fried rice with boiled peas , sometimes with meat, sausage , and eggs.

rows.Name: Fried rice ( Philippines )
rows.Description: Day-old rice fried in oil with a lot of garlic, usually eaten for breakfast with dried fish , egg and tomatoes.

rows.Name: Gaifan
rows.Description: Cooked rice covered with another dish.

rows.Name: Galho
rows.Description: A popular Naga food made from a mixture of rice, vegetables and various meats

rows.Name: Gallo pinto
rows.Origin: Central American countries such as Costa Rica and Nicaragua
rows.Description: A Central American version of rice and beans

rows.Name: Ginataang mais
rows.Description: Glutinous rice porridge with coconut milk, sugar, and corn kernels

rows.Name: Ginataang munggo
rows.Description: Glutinous rice porridge with coconut milk, sugar, and mung beans

rows.Name: Gimbap
rows.Description: Rice wrapped in seaweed ,  origin from makizushi of Japan

rows.Name: Glutinous rice cakes
rows.Description: E.g. mochi (Japan), ddeok (Korea), tangyuan , niangao , zongzi (China), and many varieties of Indonesian , Thai and Laotian cakes.

rows.Name: Goto
rows.Description: Thin rice porridge cooked with strips of ox-tripe, ginger, onion, garlic, and garnished with spring onions and calamansi .

rows.Name: Gumbo
rows.Description: A stew that is typically served over rice

rows.Name: Hainanese chicken rice
rows.Description: Hainanese chicken rice is a dish of poached chicken and seasoned rice, served with chilli sauce and usually with cucumber garnishes.

rows.Name: Hainanese curry rice
rows.Description: A Singaporean rice dish consisting of steamed white rice smothered in a mess of curries and gravy.

rows.Name: Havij Polo
rows.Description: Carrot Rice with minced meat balls  usually cooked in Tehran and other cities of Iran

rows.Name: Hoppin' John
rows.Description: Rice, black-eyed peas and pork

rows.Name: Horchata
rows.Description: Sugared rice milk .

rows.Name: Hsi htamin
rows.Description: A traditional Burmese snack or mont , popularly served as a breakfast dish, often served with sesame powder alongside peas or dried fish

rows.Name: Htamanè
rows.Description: Dessert made from glutinous rice, shredded coconuts and peanuts

rows.Name: Htamin Baung
rows.Description: Steamed rice cooked with chicken and vegetables, of Chinese origin

rows.Name: Htamin jin
rows.Description: A Burmese dish of fermented rice. It is the regional specialty and signature dish of the Intha people of Inle Lake in Shan State , Myanmar

rows.Name: Idiyappam
rows.Description: Rice noodles also known as String Hoppers. Had with curry or coconut milk

rows.Name: Idli
rows.Description: Steamed rice cakes, made with lentils or other pulses. Pictured is idli along with ramekins of sambar and a ramekin of chutney in the center of the dish.

rows.Name: Imbul Kiribath
rows.Description: Tightly wrapped Kiribath with treacle soaked scraped coconut (Pani-pol) in it.

rows.Name: Indonesian rice table
rows.Description: Rice accompanied by side dishes served in small portions. Usually known as Rijsttafel

rows.Name: Iskilip Dolmasi
rows.Description: Very specific rice food. It takes almost a day to prepare and cook. Cooked for several hundred years only in Iskilip. Extremely traditional and rare.

rows.Name: Jambalaya
rows.Description: Meat-seafood-vegetable stock to which rice is added.

rows.Name: Jíbaro
rows.Description: Yellow-rice cooked with annatto oil, sofrito, and spices with a fried egg on top.

rows.Name: Jiuniang
rows.Description: This is a sweet dish made from fermenting sticky rice with yeast. This can be eaten alone steamed, or is added to other foods.

rows.Name: Jhalmuri
rows.Description: Jhalmuri is a popular Bengali street snack , made of puffed rice and an assortment of spices, vegetables, chanachur and mustard oil.

rows.Name: Jollof rice
rows.Description: Tomato and pepper based stew to which rice is added and boiled in, and usually served with chicken, salad and fried plantain .

rows.Name: Juk
rows.Description: Generic term for porridge made from rice. There are many different varieties.

rows.Name: Kabuli pulao
rows.Description: Fried grated carrots in rice, accompanied with mixed spices and alubukhara .

rows.Name: Kabsa
rows.Description: Rice (usually long-grain, mostly basmati ) cooked with meat, spices and vegetables.

rows.Name: Kalamay
rows.Description: A sticky sweet delicacy that is popular in many regions of the Philippines. It is made of coconut milk, brown sugar, and ground glutinous rice.

rows.Name: Kande Pohe
rows.Description: A simple flattened rice dish from Maharashtra usually eaten as breakfast.

rows.Name: Kateh
rows.Description: A simple sticky-rice dish from Mazandaran and Gilan

rows.Name: Katsudon
rows.Description: A bowl of rice topped with a deep-fried pork cutlet, egg, and condiments.

rows.Name: Kedgeree
rows.Description: Flaked fish (usually smoked haddock ), boiled rice, eggs and butter.

rows.Name: Ketupat
rows.Description: (Also called Lontong ) – Rice wrapped in coconut leaves weaved pouch, boiled and serve with other food such as Satay , vegetables, fried chicken, curry, etc. It is usually served during Aidilfitri

rows.Name: Khao kan chin
rows.Description: A northern Thai dish of rice that is mixed with pork blood and steamed inside a banana leaf. It is served with cucumber, onions and fried, dried chillies.

rows.Name: Khao kha mu
rows.Description: Originally a Thai Chinese dish, it is rice served with sliced pork leg that has been stewed in soy sauce and spices

rows.Name: Khao khluk kapi
rows.Description: Rice is fried with shrimp paste and served with sweet pork, sour mango, fried shrimp, chillies and shallots.

rows.Name: Khao lam
rows.Description: Glutinous rice is boiled or steamed with sugar, and sometimes other ingredients, in a section of bamboo. Most often eaten as a snack or dessert. This is very similar to lemang .

rows.Name: Khao man kai
rows.Description: The Thai version of Hainanese chicken rice , it is made in a slightly different way than the original and served with a very different dipping sauce made from fermented soy beans, garlic, ginger, and bird's eye chilies .

rows.Name: Khao mok
rows.Description: The Thai version of a biryani , it is typical of Thai-Muslim cuisine.

rows.Name: Khao na pet
rows.Description: The Thai version of a Cantonese style roast duck served with rice

rows.Name: Khao niao mamuang
rows.Description: Sticky rice cooked in sweetened thick coconut milk, served with slices of ripe mango

rows.Name: Khao phat kaeng kiao wan
rows.Description: Rice fried with green curry

rows.Name: Khao phat kaphrao
rows.Description: Rice fried with holy basil and meat

rows.Name: Khao phat nam liap
rows.Description: Rice fried with the fruit of the Canarium album

rows.Name: Khao tom mat
rows.Description: A traditional Thai dessert made from sticky rice , coconut milk , and bananas . It's usually wrapped in banana leaf or coconut leaf.

rows.Name: Khao tom pla
rows.Description: A rice soup with fish

rows.Name: Khao yam
rows.Description: A rice salad containing fruit, vegetables, herbs, roasted coconut, and dried prawns

rows.Name: Kharcho
rows.Description: A beef and rice soup.

rows.Name: Kheer / Payas / Payasam
rows.Description: Sweet dish of rice cooked in milk with dry fruit and sugar or jaggery. Cooled before serving.

rows.Name: Khichdi
rows.Description: Rice cooked with lentils, vegetables and spices

rows.Name: Kiampong
rows.Description: A Filipino glutinous rice casserole with toasted peanuts and scallions.

rows.Name: Kiping
rows.Description: A traditional Filipino leaf-shaped wafer made from glutinous rice.

rows.Name: Kiribath
rows.Description: Cooked with milk. Also known as Milk-rice

rows.Name: Kongbap
rows.Description: Brown or white rice cooked together with beans (and sometimes also other grains)

rows.Name: Kuning
rows.Description: A Filipino rice dish cooked with turmeric, lemongrass, salt, bay leaves, and other spices

rows.Name: Kushari
rows.Description: Rice, lentils, chickpeas and macaroni topped with tomato sauce and fried onion

rows.Name: Kutsinta
rows.Description: A type of steamed rice cake (puto) found throughout the Philippines. It is made from a mixture of tapioca or rice flour, brown sugar and lye

rows.Name: Lemang
rows.Description: Glutinous rice with coconut milk cooked in bamboo stalks over open fire. Traditional dish of the Minangkabau people accompanying Rendang .

rows.Name: Lemper
rows.Description: An Indonesian savory snack made of glutinous rice filled with seasoned shredded chicken, fish or abon (meat floss).

rows.Name: Lepet
rows.Description: A type of sticky rice dumpling mixed with peanuts cooked with coconut milk packed inside janur (young coconut leaf or palm leaf).

rows.Name: Lontong
rows.Description: Made of compressed rice cake in the form of a cylinder wrapped inside a banana leaf. Rice is rolled inside a banana leaf and boiled, then cut into small cakes as a staple food replacement of steamed rice.

rows.Name: Loco Moco
rows.Description: A bowl of rice topped with a meat patty and gravy , and with a sunny side up egg on top.

rows.Name: Locrio
rows.Description: Rice, meat (Chicken, sausage, fish, etc.), tomato sauce, caramelized sugar.

rows.Name: Lokri
rows.Description: Rice, bite-size pieces of chicken, mixed vegetables, spices (also called locreo or locrio).

rows.Name: Loobia polo
rows.Description: Green beans rice with tomato paste , meat and other spices, cooked in.

rows.Name: Lo mai gai
rows.Description: Glutinous rice filled with chicken and other ingredients wrapped in a lotus leaf.

rows.Name: Lugaw
rows.Description: A Filipino glutinous rice porridge.

rows.Name: Lumpia
rows.Description: Spring rolls wrapper made from rice flour.

rows.Name: Madumongso
rows.Description: Snack made from black sticky rice as a basic ingredient. The taste is mixed with sweet because the black rice is previously processed before it becomes tapai

rows.Name: Maifun
rows.Description: This is a category which includes both dry and in-broth rice vermicelli noodle dishes. The specific dish is usually named after its non-vermicelli ingredients or its preparation. E.g. "Cao mai fun" = panfried maifun and will usually have a protein such as pork or chicken, and seasonings (usually green onion ).

rows.Name: Mamposteao ( fried rice )
rows.Description: Rice is stir-fried with bell peppers, ginger, garlic, beans, tomatoe, onions, sweet plantains , squash , herbs, spices, and the option of eggs, meat or seafood. It is typically eaten with avocado, grated queso fresco , and aïoli

rows.Name: Mandi
rows.Description: Rice cooked with meat ( lamb or chicken ), and a mixture of spices .

rows.Name: Mansaf
rows.Description: Rice is cooked separately, lamb meat is cooked in a sauce of fermented dried yogurt and served with rice or bulgur.

rows.Name: Maqluba
rows.Description: Consisting of rice and eggplant or cauliflower casserole that is then turned upside down when served. The dish can include fried tomatoes, carrots, potatoes, cauliflower, eggplant and chicken or lamb. When the casserole is inverted, the top is bright red from the tomatoes that now form the top layer and cover the golden eggplant.

rows.Name: Masa (Nigerian food) /Waina
rows.Description: Puffy dough pan bread made with rice flour

rows.Name: Masi
rows.Description: Glutinous rice balls with a peanut and muscovado filling

rows.Name: Moa
rows.Description: Moa is a small sweet and crispy ball made of puffed rice and jaggery. It originated from South 24 Parganas district of West Bengal .

rows.Name: Moa'amar
rows.Description: Rice with milk and chicken soup. A sort of rice made by adding milk and chicken soup to the rice and letting it into the oven. Eaten instead of white rice. Very popular in Egypt .

rows.Name: Moche
rows.Description: Filipino glutinous rice balls with a bean paste filling.

rows.Name: Mochi
rows.Description: Mochi is Japanese rice cake made of mochigome , a short-grain japonica glutinous rice , and sometimes other ingredients such as water, sugar, and cornstarch . The rice is pounded into paste and molded into the desired shape.

rows.Name: Mochi ice cream
rows.Description: Mochi ice cream is a small, round confection consisting of a soft, pounded sticky rice dumpling ( mochi ) formed around an ice cream filling.

rows.Name: Moffle
rows.Description: A waffle prepared using mochi

rows.Name: Mont di
rows.Description: A thin rice noodle dish, a semi staple dish of Rakhine State . Rakhine Mont de is either a salad with dry roasted conger eel and chili or as a soup. Mandalay mont de is with larger rice noodles, with meat based sauce.

rows.Name: Mont lin maya
rows.Description: A fritter made with rice flour , where two halves (thus 'Couple') are fried with quail eggs , steamed garden beans, spring onions. The halves are then connected and sprinkled with salted roasted sesame.

rows.Name: Morón
rows.Description: A Filipino rice cake made with glutinous rice, coconut milk, and chocolate

rows.Name: Mosaranna
rows.Description: Curd rice , considered a staple food of brahmins of the Karnataka state of South India . In this dish, curd is added to cooked rice and eaten straight away. Sometimes mustard seeds , red chillies, curry leaves and lentils are fried in oil and added to the dish. To add more flavour, ginger-garlic paste and finely chopped red onions are also added to the yogurt and rice mixture. Fresh, finely chopped cilantro is used as garnish.

rows.Name: Mujaddara
rows.Description: Fried rice with lentil, served with yogurt and salad.

rows.Name: Muri
rows.Description: A very common snack from Indian subcontinent .It is a traditional puffed rice made by heating parboiled rice (i.e. steamed then dried) in a karahi or wok filled with hot salt or sand, a technique known as hot salt frying .

rows.Name: Nasi ambeng
rows.Description: A fragrant rice dish that consists of – but is not limited to – steamed white rice, chicken curry or chicken stewed in soy sauce, beef or chicken rendang, sambal goreng (lit. fried sambal; a mildly spicy stir-fried stew commonly made with firm tofu, tempeh, and long beans) urap, bergedel, and serunding.

rows.Name: Nasi bakar
rows.Description: Indonesian for "burned rice" or "grilled rice". Nasi bakar refer to steamed rice seasoned with spices and ingredients and wrapped in banana leaf secured with lidi semat (small needle made of central rib of coconut leaf) and later grilled upon charcoal fire.

rows.Name: Nasi Beringin
rows.Description: A rice dish from Johor , originally served for Johorean royalties.

rows.Name: Nasi bogana
rows.Description: An-Indonesian style rice dish, originally from Tegal, Central Java. It is usually wrapped in banana leaves and served with side dishes

rows.Name: Nasi campur
rows.Description: Literally "mixed rice" in Indonesian; also called nasi rames in Indonesia. Nasi campur refers to a dish of rice topped with various meat and vegetable dishes, peanuts, eggs and fried-shrimp krupuk .

rows.Name: Nasi dagang
rows.Description: Rice steamed in coconut milk , fish curry and extra ingredients such as fried shaved coconut , hard-boiled eggs and vegetable pickles .

rows.Name: Nasi goreng
rows.Description: This is type of fried rice usually cooked with shrimp paste , chicken, meat, salted fish or/and vegetables.

rows.Name: Nasi gurih
rows.Description: Nasi gurih is made by cooking mixture of rice and sticky rice soaked in coconut milk instead of water, along with salt, lemongrass, Indian bay leaf, and pandan leaves to add aroma.

rows.Name: Nasi jinggo
rows.Description: Nasi jinggo is a Balinese typical fast food that is packaged with small portions of banana leaves.

rows.Name: Nasi kandar
rows.Description: Famously served by local Indian Muslims, and very popular in Penang .

rows.Name: Nasi kapau
rows.Description: Nasi kapau is a Minang steamed rice topped with various choices of dishes originated from Nagari Kapau, Bukittinggi, West Sumatra, Indonesia.

rows.Name: Nasi katok
rows.Description: Composed of steamed rice, ayam goreng (fried chicken) and a spicy sambal sauce.

rows.Name: Nasi kebuli
rows.Description: An Indonesian variant of pilaf. It consists of rice cooked in goat meat broth, goat milk, and clarified butter (most often ghee).

rows.Name: Nasi kerabu
rows.Description: Dish from Kelantan, consisting of rice with various wild herbs and spices, grated coconut and dried shrimp or fish.

rows.Name: Nasi kucing
rows.Description: An Indonesian rice dish that originated from Yogyakarta, Semarang, and Surakarta but has since spread. It consists of a small portion of rice with toppings, usually sambal, dried fish, and tempeh, wrapped in banana leaves.

rows.Name: Nasi kuning
rows.Description: ( Indonesian for: "yellow rice"), or sometimes called nasi kunyit (Indonesian for: "turmeric rice"), is an Indonesian rice dish cooked with coconut milk and turmeric ,

rows.Name: Nasi lemak
rows.Description: Coconut steamed rice

rows.Name: Nasi lemuni
rows.Description: A rice dish prepared with a herb, Vitex trifolia , locally known as lemuni.

rows.Name: Nasi liwet
rows.Description: An Indonesian dish rice dish cooked in coconut milk, chicken broth and spices

rows.Name: Nasi padang
rows.Description: Steamed rice served with various choices of pre-cooked dishes , it is a miniature banquet of meats, fish, vegetables, and spicy sambals eaten with plain white rice, it is Sumatra's most famous export and the Minangkabau's great contribution to Indonesian cuisine .

rows.Name: Nasi tim
rows.Description: In Indonesian language nasi means (cooked) rice and tim means steam. The ingredients are chicken, mushroom and hard boiled egg. These are seasoned in soy sauce and garlic, and then placed at the bottom of a tin bowl. This tin bowl is then filled with rice and steamed until cooked. This dish is usually served with light chicken broth and chopped leeks.

rows.Name: Nasi timbel
rows.Description: An Indonesian hot dish, consisting of steamed rice wrapped inside a banana leaf

rows.Name: Nasi tutug oncom
rows.Description: An Indonesian style rice dish, made of rice mixed with oncom fermented beans

rows.Name: Nasi tumpang
rows.Description: Rice with different layer of dishes wrapped in a cone shape with banana leaf packed

rows.Name: Nasi uduk
rows.Description: Steamed rice cooked in coconut milk

rows.Name: Nasi ulam
rows.Description: An Indonesian steamed rice dish mixed with various herbs, especially the leaves of Asiatic pennywort (Centella asiatica) or often replaced with kemangi (lemon basil), vegetables, spices and accompanied with various side dishes

rows.Name: Nurungji
rows.Description: A traditional Korean food made of scorched rice. After boiling and serving rice, a thin crust of scorched rice will usually be left in the bottom of the cooking pot. This yellowed scorched state is described as 'nureun' ( Korean : 눌은 ) in Korean and nurungji derives from this adjective.

rows.Name: Ofada rice
rows.Description: Nigerian rice sometimes served in palm leaves. It is made from locally produced rice that is grown almost entirely in Ogun State .  It is typically consumed with a meat-based stew like lafenwa sauce, Ofada sauce, ayamase or with a vegetable stew,  . Eggs are also common alongside the dish many times soaked in the tomato and pepper based stews.

rows.Name: Ogokbab
rows.Description: A traditional Korean food cooked with five grains. One of the Daeboreum foods for the Lunar New Year , rice is cooked by mixing glutinous rice, red bean, glutinous millet, black beans, sticky sorghum etc.

rows.Name: Okowa
rows.Description: Sticky glutinous rice mixed with various vegetables or meat and steamed

rows.Name: Okoy
rows.Description: Filipino crispy deep-fried fritters made with glutinous rice batter, unshelled small shrimp, and various vegetables, including calabaza, sweet potato, cassava, mung bean sprouts, scallions and julienned carrots, onions, and green papaya.

rows.Name: Omurice
rows.Description: An omelette made with fried rice and thin, fried scrambled eggs , usually topped with ketchup

rows.Name: Onigiri
rows.Description: Short grained rice formed into balls with or without savory fillings, a popular snack.

rows.Name: Orez Shu'it
rows.Description: Consists of white beans cooked in a tomato paste and served on white rice.

rows.Name: Pabellón criollo
rows.Description: Rice, shredded beef and stewed black beans.

rows.Name: Paella
rows.Description: A rice dish that takes its name from the wide, shallow traditional pan used to cook the dish on an open fire. It can contain a variety of meats, beans, and vegetables, and is usually colored yellow by the inclusion of saffron .

rows.Name: Palitaw
rows.Description: A small, flat, sweet rice cake made by boiling rice batter until they float

rows.Name: Pancit bihon
rows.Description: Noodles made from rice flour, also refers to the cooked dish made with rice noodles with slivers of meat, seafood and vegetables such as onions, carrots, beans, cabbage, seasoned with soy sauce and calamansi

rows.Name: Pakhala
rows.Description: A type of Fermented Rice, typically served with Curd, fish, badi, spinach etc. Mainly Consumed in the Indian state of Odisha

rows.Name: Panta bhat
rows.Description: A traditional Filipino fried rice pancake.

rows.Name: Panyalam
rows.Description: A traditional Filipino fried rice pancake. It is made with ground glutinous rice, muscovado (or brown sugar), and coconut milk mixed into a batter that is deep-fried.

rows.Name: Pastil
rows.Description: A Filipino packed rice dish made with steamed rice wrapped in banana leaves with dry shredded beef, chicken, or fish.

rows.Name: Perde pilavı
rows.Description: A special pilav with chicken meat, all wrapped inside yufka , thin Turkish dough, and cooked in an oven

rows.Name: Phở
rows.Description: Rice noodle soup

rows.Name: Pilaf (or Pilau)
rows.Description: Rice cooked in a seasoned broth .  In some cases, the rice may also attain its brown color by being stirred with bits of cooked onion, as well as a large mix of spices . Depending on the local cuisine, it may also contain meat , fish , vegetables , and ( dried ) fruits .

rows.Name: Pinipig
rows.Description: A flattened rice dish from the Philippines. It is made of immature grains of glutinous rice pounded until flat before being toasted.

rows.Name: Pitha
rows.Origin: West Bengal , Assam , Odisha , Tripura , Bangladesh
rows.Description: Pithas are primarily made from a dough or batter of rice flour or wheat flour, which is shaped and optionally filled with sweet or savory ingredients called " Pur " which consists grated coconut stirred in syrup or baked or fried vegetable. There is also many other types of Pithas that doesn't contains " Pur " and can simply be made by frying rice flower batter in vegetable oil like a pancake.

rows.Name: Pittu
rows.Description: Steamed rice cake.

rows.Name: Moros y Cristianos
rows.Description: White rice and black beans cooked together with spices.

rows.Name: Plov
rows.Description: Medium grain rice with carrots, onions, spices, lamb, and cottonseed oil

rows.Name: Poha
rows.Description: Poha is a popular Indian snack prepared by frying water soaked flattened rice in ghee or vegetable oil with chilies , onions, cumin seeds , mustard seeds , peanuts , boiled potatoes and curry leaves (called Kadi-patta).

rows.Name: Pongal
rows.Description: Sakkara pongal : A sweet rice dish, cooked with rice, moong dhal, jaggery and milk, flavoured with cardamom and garnished with cashew and raisins. Ven / Katte pongal: rice, moong dhal, milk, salt, pepper corns, ginger , cummin seeds and curry leaves.

rows.Name: Poule au riz
rows.Description: Consists of a poached or braised chicken served with rice cooked in the chicken's cooking liquid.

rows.Name: Puffed rice cakes
rows.Description: Commonly used in breakfast cereal or snack foods, and served as a popular street food.

rows.Name: Pulihora
rows.Description: Pulihora is rice seasoned with tamarind.

rows.Name: Puso
rows.Description: Rice filled inside a pouch made with woven strips of coconut frond then boiled.

rows.Name: Puto
rows.Description: A steamed rice cake made from stone-ground soaked rice with coconut milk. Various toppings such as cheese, salted egg, or minced meat may be added.

rows.Name: Puto bumbong
rows.Description: A Filipino purple rice cake steamed in bamboo tubes.

rows.Name: Puto seco
rows.Description: Filipino cookies made from ground glutinous rice, cornstarch, sugar, salt, butter, and eggs.

rows.Name: Puttu
rows.Description: Steamed rice cake.

rows.Name: Qidreh
rows.Description: A rice and meat dish traditionally prepared in a clay pot that is cooked in a wood fired oven

rows.Name: Quzi
rows.Description: A lamb and rice dish popular in the Arab world with many variations

rows.Name: Red beans & rice
rows.Description: Staple made with kidney beans, ham bones, pickled pork, andouille , onion, celery, bell pepper and seasonings.

rows.Name: Rice and curry
rows.Description: A meal of plain, spiced, or fried rice which is served together with several other dishes, of which at least one is a curry, on one plate, but sometimes with the other dishes on the side.

rows.Name: Rice and gravy
rows.Description: A staple of Creole and Cajun cuisine

rows.Name: Rice and Obe ata
rows.Description: Rice and a tomato-pepper based stew and sauces with meat,fish and/or eggs

rows.Name: Rice and peas
rows.Description: Rice with kidney beans, black-eyed peas or pigeon peas

rows.Name: Rice bath
rows.Description: A seasoned rice with vegetables (Such as egg-plant, peas, tomato), a breakfast dish from Karnataka , India

rows.Name: Rice bread
rows.Description: Bread made from rice flour .

rows.Name: Rice cakes
rows.Description: A rice cake may be any kind of food item made from rice that has been shaped, condensed, or otherwise combined into a single object.

rows.Name: Rice krispies
rows.Description: A breakfast cereal made of crisped rice . Rice Krispies are also used to make Rice Krispies treats by combining the cereal with melted marshmallows .

rows.Name: Rice noodle roll
rows.Description: A thin roll made from a wide strip of shahe fen , filled with shrimp, beef, and vegetables.

rows.Name: Rice pudding
rows.Description: Sweet dish of rice cooked in milk, coconut milk or other thickening liquid. Eaten with various spices, fruits, condiments, etc. in different regions.

rows.Name: Risotto
rows.Description: Rice dish made by first frying in butter after which broth is added.

rows.Name: Riz Casimir
rows.Description: Curry rice with sliced veal and fruits

rows.Name: Riz gras
rows.Description: A dish with meat and vegetables atop rice.

rows.Name: Salukara
rows.Description: A type of pancake of the Waray people in Eastern Samar, Philippines. It is made with galapong (or glutinous rice flour), coconut milk, sugar, and water.

rows.Name: Sandige
rows.Description: Deep fried meal accompaniment made with rice, sago and ash gourd

rows.Name: Sapin-sapin
rows.Description: A layered glutinous rice and coconut dessert in Philippine cuisine. It is made from rice flour, coconut milk, sugar, water, flavoring and coloring.

rows.Name: Satti Sorru
rows.Description: Satti soru, which means wok rice in Tamil, is a fairly common dish in South Indian households.Gravy from a curry is mixed into rice, to clean out the pan or the wok the curry was cooked in.

rows.Name: San Pyote
rows.Description: Burmese rice congree with either duck or fish

rows.Name: Sarma
rows.Description: Grape or cabbage leaves stuffed (rolled with) rice, various herbs and spices.

rows.Name: Şehriyeli pilav , pilaf with orzo
rows.Description: Dish consisting of rice , with orzo .

rows.Name: Sel roti
rows.Description: Ring shaped bread made from rice flour and eaten during Hindu festivals, especially Tihar .

rows.Name: Serabi
rows.Description: An Indonesian pancake that is made from rice flour with coconut milk or just plain shredded coconut as an emulsifier . Each province in Indonesia has various serabi recipes corresponding to local tastes.

rows.Name: Shirin polo
rows.Description: A traditional Persian Jewish rice dish that is commonly served to mark special occasions such as weddings, Purim, Pesach, Rosh Hashanah and the high holidays.

rows.Name: Sholezard
rows.Description: This is a saffron rice dessert with nuts and rosewater

rows.Name: Shrimp Creole
rows.Description: Cooked shrimp in a mixture of whole or diced tomatoes, the Holy trinity of onion, celery and bell pepper, spiced with Tabasco sauce or another hot pepper sauce or cayenne-based seasoning, and served over steamed or boiled white rice.

rows.Name: Shwe htamin
rows.Description: Burmese dessert dish, baked sweetened glutinous rice and jaggery

rows.Name: Shwe yin aye
rows.Description: Dessert dish consisting of glutinous rice , coconut milk and jelly

rows.Name: Sinangag
rows.Description: Fried rice sauteed in garlic. A vital part of the "silog" meal ("Sinangag at Itlog"; trans: "fried rice and egg")

rows.Name: Siopao
rows.Description: Steamed meat dumpling made with rice flour

rows.Name: Spanish rice
rows.Description: Side dish made from white rice, tomatoes, garlic, onions, green and red bell peppers and other ingredients.

rows.Name: Steamed rice
rows.Description: Cooked rice

rows.Name: Sticky rice
rows.Description: Rice dish commonly made from glutinous rice and can include soy sauce, oyster sauce , scallions , cilantro and other ingredients

rows.Name: Stir fry
rows.Description: Pictured is Thai Phat naem sai khai, sausage of rice-fermented raw pork skin stir fried with egg.

rows.Name: Suman
rows.Description: Sticky rice cooked with coconut milk and sugar and wrapped in banana or coconut leaves.

rows.Name: Sushi
rows.Description: Sticky rice flavored with vinegar and sugar, with various fillings or toppings

rows.Name: Sweet saffron rice
rows.Description: Dish consisting of joha rice , sugar and saffron .

rows.Name: Szczecin paprikash
rows.Description: A fish, rice, and tomato spread, often canned. It can be classified as a fast food and remains a delicacy in the port city of Szczecin .

rows.Name: Taco rice
rows.Description: Taco-flavored ground beef served on a bed of rice, frequently served with shredded cheese, shredded lettuce, tomato, and salsa.

rows.Name: Tahdig
rows.Description: A specialty of Iranian cuisine consisting of crisp, caramelized  rice taken from the bottom of the pot in which the rice ( chelow ) is cooked.

rows.Name: Tangyuan
rows.Description: A traditional (at least from the Ming dynasty) food that is made from glutinous rice paste that has been rolled into small balls, boiled, then put into a soup base. These are traditionally white in color. Sometimes savory or sweet stuffings (such as red bean paste) are added.

rows.Name: Tapai
rows.Description: A traditional Indonesian fermented rice cakes which is made from sticky rice sugar and yeast. Tapai is wrapped with banana leaves. The taste is sweet and sour because of the fermentation. Tapai usually can be added to traditional beverage like Es Cendol or eaten by itself. The other version of tapai is Tapai Singkong (Tape Singkong). Tapai Singkong is fermented steamed cassava.

rows.Name: Teurgoule
rows.Description: Rice pudding that is a speciality of Normandy

rows.Name: Thai fried rice
rows.Description: Fried jasmine rice, usually containing meat (chicken, shrimp, and crab are all common), egg, onions, garlic, and sometimes tomatoes.

rows.Name: Thalassery biryani
rows.Description: Also known as Malabar biryani , Thalassery biryani is a rice-based dish made with spices, rice (khyma rice, and not basmati rice) and chicken (specially dressed for biriyani). Variations upon the dish may use mutton , fish, eggs or vegetables.

rows.Name: Thingyan rice
rows.Description: Fully boiled rice in candle-smelt water served with pickled marian plums

rows.Name: Tinapayan
rows.Description: A Filipino dish consisting of tapay (fermented cooked rice) and dried fish.

rows.Name: Tinutuan
rows.Description: Tinutuan is a congee made from rice, pumpkin and sweet potato or cassava cooked up into a pulp.

rows.Name: Tube rice pudding
rows.Description: This is Taiwanese dish consisting of a stir-fried glutinous rice mixture that is seasoned with shiitake mushroom, minced pork, rousong , shallots and steamed in a bamboo tube.

rows.Name: Tupig
rows.Description: A Filipino rice cake originating from northwestern Luzon, made from ground slightly-fermented soaked glutinous rice (galapong) mixed with coconut milk, muscovado sugar, and young coconut (buko) strips. It is wrapped into a cylindrical form in banana leaves and baked directly on charcoal, with frequent turning.

rows.Name: Tuwo
rows.Description: Rice balls as a type of Okele made to be eaten with stews and soups.

rows.Name: Waakye
rows.Description: Rice and beans cooked with waakye leaves to give it a brownish colour. Eaten with shito and eggs, meat or fish.

rows.Name: Xôi
rows.Description: Glutinous rice mixed with a variety of other ingredients, can be made savory or sweet.

rows.Name: Yabra'
rows.Description: Grape leaves stuffed with rice and cooked with vegetables. The dish name differs from one country to another.

rows.Name: Yakimochi
rows.Description: Literally grilled or broiled mochi or pounded rice cake . Traditionally, it is prepared using a small charcoal grill but in modern times a gas grill can be used. During the time of the Autumn Moon it is traditional to eat fresh yakimochi while sipping sake and enjoying the view of the full moon .

rows.Name: Yay Monte
rows.Description: Thin savory rice pancake with boiled garden peas, spring onions and salted sesame garnish

rows.Name: Yangzhou fried rice
rows.Description: A popular Chinese -style wok fried rice dish in many Chinese restaurants in China , the Americas , Australia , United Kingdom , Vietnam , and the Philippines . The ingredients vary, but there are staple items such as cooked rice (preferably day-old because freshly cooked rice is too sticky, barbecued pork, Cooked shrimp , scallions (spring onions or green onions), chopped, including green ends and egg yolks .

rows.Name: Yin yang fried rice
rows.Description: Dish served with chicken in tomato sauce on one side, and shrimp and peas in an egg white sauce on the other, shaped into a yin yang symbol, with rice as base.

rows.Name: Zarda
rows.Description: Sweet dish of rice cooked in clarified butter / banaspati oil with a variety of dried fruits such as orange in color

rows.Name: Zeera rice / Jeera rice
rows.Description: Steamed rice, Zeera ( cumin ), Zeera powder, ginger-garlic paste, salt, oil, chana dal and red chillies are cooked together to prepare this dish.

rows.Name: Zereshk polo
rows.Description: This is caramelized barberries sprinkled on plain buttery basmati rice and served usually with chicken.

rows.Name: Zongzi
rows.Description: Glutinous rice, stuffed with various ingredients and wrapped in bamboo leaves

rows.Name: Uppudu pindi
rows.Description: A rice dish made from rice flour, made like upma , eaten in Telangana .

rows.Name: Zosui
rows.Description: A rice soup made from pre-cooked rice and water. Leftover soup from nabe is often re-used for zosui.
